description.zh: 讨论分工、协作、激励与人机边界。
description.en: Roles, collaboration, incentives and human-AI boundaries.

zh: 请从组织参谋的角度，提出一个值得讨论的假设。
请从组织参谋的角度，回应前一位参谋的具体观点。
请从组织参谋的角度，给出一个最小验证动作。
en: As the Organization advisor, offer one hypothesis to discuss.
As the Organization advisor, respond to the preceding advisor's specific claim.
As the Organization advisor, suggest one small validation step.
